newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian stocks rise on positive economic outlook.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian stocks rise on positive economic outlook.

text.p: Norwegian shares continued on an upward path on Friday as investors went on the buying trail, buoyed by the healthy domestic economy. Dealers said they expected the advance to continue.
The Total share index rose 0.79 percent to 929.59 points as turnover jumped more than 30 percent from Thursday to 945 million crowns.
"The economy is very good and that is bringing cash into the market. I think we'll continue to go up for the next couple of months," said one broker.

The government's unveiling of the final budget proposal, which maintains a tight fiscal stance despite opposition pressure to increase spending, had reassured any remaining nervous investors, he said.
Norwegian shipbuilder Kvaerner rose strongly after it announced it had won a $1 billion order to build two cruise liners which will be the world's largest, able to carry 3,100 passengers each.
Kvaerner A peaked at 273 crowns before ending 5.50 crowns up at 265.50 crowns. The B also closed 5.50 higher at 244 crowns.
